authority.presentation: read-only consumers; widgets never mutate progression
forbidden: QuillScript canonical save, quest, travel, or reward ownership
local capability grant or duplicated traversal state machine
runtime-only unlock state with no canonical key

chapter.title: Future movement title — owner input required

declares: chapter identity, order, prerequisites, beat membership, quest membership, exit objectives, and checkpoint
ordered beat prerequisites, objectives, checkpoint, interrupt policy, and intent IDs
quest prerequisites, ordered beats/objectives, accept and complete intents, rewards, consequences, and restore policy
ordered state rules, prerequisites, completion/failure intents, flags, effects, tracker presentation, and checkpoint
readable emotional turn and traversal choice
ordered player-facing map legs, spawn tags, route marker references, and safe failure behavior
future route and map references without moving the player from Quill or a widget

route_references.map_name_policy: map names live in route data; widgets and Quill do not own travel

declares: one primary encounter, its activation gate, result branches, and reset/idempotency behavior

rewards.title: Durable chapter reward — owner input required

declares: one durable reward, its allowlisted ID, grant intent, and presentation fallback

form_unlocks.lookup_owner: UMelodiaWardrobeSubsystem as read-only resonant-form capability lookup

readability_obligations: The emotional turn is legible before the traversal decision.
The active objective and route prompt remain readable after skip, interruption, and restore.

rules: chapter_stays within its authored target window before roster or system breadth expands

emotional_turn.before: The movement opens with a stable belief or emotional avoidance — owner input required.
emotional_turn.turn: One authored discovery changes what the player understands — owner input required.
emotional_turn.after: The player leaves with a changed relationship to the route or companion — owner input required.
emotional_turn.player_facing_signal: A readable Quill line, choice, or world response makes the turn observable without relying on hidden flags.

traversal_decision.prompt: Traversal decision prompt — owner input required.

options.description: Take the first authored route option — owner input required.
options.route_effect: route leg or traversal mode A — owner input required.

options.description: Take the second authored route option — owner input required.
options.route_effect: route leg or traversal mode B — owner input required.

traversal_decision.authority: UMelodiaTravelSubsystem for map travel; UMelodiaTraversalComponent for movement mode

consequence.trigger: The traversal decision and primary encounter/non-combat result resolve.

branches.presentation: The route shows the authored success consequence — owner input required.
The route shows the authored failure consequence — owner input required.
The route shows the authored retreat consequence — owner input required.
The chosen route remains readable after travel and restore.

checkpoint.label: Future movement continuation point — owner input required.
checkpoint.restore_behavior: Quill restarts from an authored label and the read model recomputes without replaying consumed intents

exit_criteria.criterion: A concrete progression package validates against the existing progression schema and supplies stable chapter, beat, quest, objective, intent, reward, consequence, flag, and checkpoint IDs.
exit_criteria.verification: Run the focused chapter-package validator and the progression package's existing offline checks.

exit_criteria.criterion: Checked-in Quill source owns dialogue flow and routes only stable melodia notifications through UMelodiaNarrativeSubsystem.
exit_criteria.verification: Inspect .qsc source and compile/materialization evidence; no direct save, quest, battle, or travel authority is present.

exit_criteria.criterion: The player route and integration proof map are explicit, with travel requests owned by UMelodiaTravelSubsystem.
exit_criteria.verification: Resolve route references, compile the owner materialization, and record map/spawn readback.

exit_criteria.criterion: Exactly one traversal decision, one emotional turn, one encounter or non-combat consequence, one durable reward, and one checkpoint are playable and readable.
exit_criteria.verification: Owner playtest records each decision branch and the resulting canonical flags/objectives.

exit_criteria.criterion: Save, process restart, and Continue restore the checkpoint and objective read model without duplicate intents, rewards, or consequences.
exit_criteria.verification: Fresh-slot and Continue route evidence records the canonical record fields and exactly-once journal deltas.

Cosmetic definition and canonical unlock-state boundaries.
Resonant-form capability declaration and traversal enforcement boundaries.

owner_inputs.question: What are the concrete movement slug, chapter order, title, prerequisites, quest ID, beat IDs, objective IDs, intent IDs, and checkpoint ID?
owner_inputs.blocks: Binding progression_package_ref and replacing every placeholder ID pattern.

owner_inputs.question: Which checked-in .qsc source, labels, choices, and stable melodia notifications express the movement?
owner_inputs.blocks: Quill source binding and dialogue compilation evidence.

owner_inputs.question: Which map legs, spawn tags, route markers, and traversal modes are the player-facing route?
Is the primary encounter combat or non-combat, which result branches matter, and which existing stock authority executes it?
owner_inputs.blocks: Encounter binding, allowlist review, and result-branch evidence.

owner_inputs.question: What is the single emotional turn and how is it made legible to the player?
What single traversal decision has exactly which two or more authored route outcomes?
What durable reward, cosmetic, and Resonant Form/capability unlock are granted, if any?
owner_inputs.blocks: Reward, wardrobe, form, and canonical flag allowlists.

owner_inputs.question: What are the minimum, target, and maximum minutes and per-beat readability targets?
owner_inputs.blocks: Pacing acceptance and chapter breadth decisions.

offline.assertion: The template validates against this JSON Schema and declares every required chapter-package section.
The template is source/spec-only, has no Unreal asset claim, and uses stable ID patterns rather than live future IDs.
Progression, Quill, save, travel, traversal, encounter, wardrobe, form, and presentation ownership matches the existing contracts.
The existing progression schema/IDs, Quill contract, route split, wardrobe contract, capability gate, and traversal contract resolve.
The package requires canonical checkpoint restore and exactly-once intent/reward/consequence semantics without adding a save authority.

live.assertion: One editor owner materializes the authored sources, compiles, saves, and re-reads the package-bound assets.
Owner-controlled PIE observes the emotional turn, traversal decision, encounter consequence, reward, checkpoint, and readable objective tracker.
The packaged route repeats the same checkpoint and exactly-once behavior without editor-only relaxed IDs.
